freezelineLines.line: The Suburb is still frozen from your scream.

applyLines.line: The Suburb is frozen — War Cry. (stunned: no movement)

bellowLines.line: You BELLOW — raw, wordless, from the gut. They hold their ground, but they heard you. (War Cry)
